What these numbers mean

Bounce rate: completed or inactive visits with no input and less than 30 seconds of active time, divided by completed or inactive visits. A visit becomes inactive after two minutes without a heartbeat. Reloading starts a new visit; Try again starts another attempt in the same visit.

Active time: time in a visible game tab, excluding Top 10/About pauses, time after an outcome, and idle periods after 60 seconds without input. Reading and watching the intro count until that idle threshold. Heartbeats are sent every 15 seconds; a forced browser close may lose the last few seconds.

Coverage: first-party, browser-reported analytics—not verified people or cheat-proof scores. Privacy signals, blockers, offline visits and failed requests may reduce coverage. Local development and this dashboard are excluded. Official-site data appears only after the updated game is published there.
